column1: # xflow dev pack. Fields (TAB-separated; trailing ones may be omitted; - = none):
# canonical, safe heard forms, cued heard forms, left cues, right cues, left blockers, right blockers, continuations after a left cue.
# A heard form is how speech-to-text mis-hears exactly the canonical: lowercase ASCII words, nothing extra.
# Safe forms: every word is not English, not a name, not a digit or single letter, and the form is more than a case change.
# Cued forms need an adjacent non-English cue; an English left cue (ask, hey, tell) also needs a continuation (to, about, for).
# Cued forms change only lowercase input. See NOTICE.
